# 05 — Data Dictionary

*Generated by `python -m analysis.data_dictionary`, read from the warehouse catalog. Do not edit by hand.*

---

## `stg_airport`

**Staging** · 6,075 rows

Airport reference from OpenFlights plus four hand-added overrides. The timezone column is load-bearing: without it no clock field in the BTS feed can be compared across airports.

| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| `airport_code` | VARCHAR |
| `airport_name` | VARCHAR |
| `city` | VARCHAR |
| `country` | VARCHAR |
| `latitude` | DOUBLE |
| `longitude` | DOUBLE |
| `timezone` | VARCHAR |

## `stg_flight`

**Staging** · 33,653,101 rows

The BTS extract with every clock field resolved to UTC. Arrival instants are derived forward from the departure instant using scheduled block time and reported delay, which has no date-wrap edge cases.

## `dim_airport`

**Dimension** · 382 rows

Airports appearing in the window. `size_band` is derived from share of departures using the FAA hub thresholds — close to the official categories but not identical, since the FAA uses enplanements.

| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| `airport_code` | VARCHAR |
| `airport_name` | VARCHAR |
| `city` | VARCHAR |
| `country` | VARCHAR |
| `latitude` | DOUBLE |
| `longitude` | DOUBLE |
| `timezone` | VARCHAR |
| `departures` | BIGINT |
| `arrivals` | BIGINT |
| `departure_share` | DOUBLE |
| `size_band` | VARCHAR |
| `is_mapped` | BOOLEAN |

## `dim_carrier`

**Dimension** · 17 rows

Operating carriers. BTS reports the operator, not the marketing brand: a United-branded regional flight appears under the regional's code.

| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| `carrier` | VARCHAR |
| `carrier_name` | VARCHAR |
| `carrier_type` | VARCHAR |
| `operates_for` | VARCHAR |
| `is_mapped` | BOOLEAN |
| `flights` | BIGINT |
| `first_seen` | DATE |
| `last_seen` | DATE |

## `dim_date`

**Dimension** · 1,826 rows

Calendar with federal holidays and travel-period flags. The travel period matters more than the holiday — Thanksgiving Day itself is one of the quietest flying days of the year.

| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| `date_day` | DATE |
| `year` | BIGINT |
| `quarter` | BIGINT |
| `month` | BIGINT |
| `month_name` | VARCHAR |
| `day_of_month` | BIGINT |
| `iso_day_of_week` | BIGINT |
| `day_name` | VARCHAR |
| `is_weekend` | BOOLEAN |
| `holiday_name` | VARCHAR |
| `is_federal_holiday` | BOOLEAN |
| `travel_period` | VARCHAR |
